drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un hexagone dont les six sommets sont marqués d'un point, deux côtés opposés repassés en gras ; à l'intérieur, en tirets, ses trois diagonales et ses deux triangles inscrits.
drawings.kind: hexagon with its diagonals and its two inscribed triangles
drawings.notes: Left margin, beside « Soit H = (S, A, R) un hexagone combinatoire ». Six vertices placed once, each with a full point; the six sides, the top and the bottom ones gone over heavily; inside, in dashes, the three diagonals and the two inscribed triangles, drawn between the same vertices so that they meet exactly. On the page the inner lines are loose short dashes; they follow the nine lines drawn here (the text of the page speaks of the three diagonals and the two inscribed triangles of H). Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, un polygone dessiné sur un cercle : le cercle porte alternativement quatre points et quatre croix ; l'arc qui va d'un point au suivant en passant par une croix est épaissi.
drawings.kind: polygon on a circle: vertices (points) and sides (crosses) alternating
drawings.notes: Right of the first lines. A freehand circle drawn as a circle; on it, alternately, four full points and four crosses, at the angles read on the page (computed points of the circle); the arc from the upper point round the left to the lower left point, which passes through one cross, is gone over heavily. It is the picture of the duality between vertices and sides of a polygon (S and A) of which the page speaks. The note of the transcription says « un arc épaissi entre deux points »: the heavy arc runs between two consecutive points and carries the cross between them. The cross on the heavy arc is larger and has an extra stroke on the page. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
